title: Rebuilding the Wall

questions.question: Who rose up with his brothers the priests to build?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 3:1 (ESV): "Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brothers the priests..."

questions.question: Which gate did the high priest build?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 3:1 (ESV): "...and they built the Sheep Gate."

questions.question: Who built next to Eliashib?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 3:2 (ESV): "And next to him the men of Jericho built."

questions.question: What group’s nobles would not stoop to serve their Lord?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 3:5 (ESV): "...but their nobles would not stoop to serve their Lord."

questions.question: Who repaired the Fish Gate?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 3:3 (ESV): "The sons of Hassenaah built the Fish Gate..."

questions.question: What profession did Uzziel belong to?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 3:8 (ESV): "Next to them Uzziel... one of the goldsmiths, repaired."

questions.question: Who repaired the wall next to Uzziel?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 3:8 (ESV): "Next to him Hananiah, one of the perfumers, repaired."

questions.question: Who repaired the section opposite his house?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 3:10 (ESV): "Next to them Jedaiah... repaired opposite his house."

questions.question: Who repaired the Valley Gate?
options: Hanun and the inhabitants of Zanoah
questions.correctAnswer: Hanun and the inhabitants of Zanoah
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 3:13 (ESV): "Hanun and the inhabitants of Zanoah repaired the Valley Gate..."

questions.question: Where did the temple servants live?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 3:26 (ESV): "(and the temple servants living on Ophel repaired to a point opposite the Water Gate...)"

questions.question: Which two daughters are specifically mentioned helping repair?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 3:12 (ESV): "...Shallum... repaired, he and his daughters."

questions.question: What did the Tekoites repair a second section opposite to?
options: The great projecting tower as far as the wall of Ophel
questions.correctAnswer: The great projecting tower as far as the wall of Ophel
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 3:27 (ESV): "...repaired another section opposite the great projecting tower as far as the wall of Ophel."

questions.question: Who repaired above the Horse Gate?
options: The priests, each opposite his own house
questions.correctAnswer: The priests, each opposite his own house
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 3:28 (ESV): "Above the Horse Gate the priests repaired, each one opposite his own house."

questions.question: To where did the goldsmiths and merchants repair?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 3:32 (ESV): "...as far as the Sheep Gate the goldsmiths and the merchants repaired."

key_verse_text: Above the Horse Gate the priests repaired, each one opposite his own house.
